Manager, Technical – Civil & Structural

  • Full-time
  • Business unit: Chief Operating Office
  • Division: Engineering

Company Description

Established in 2006, Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) is a global clean energy leader, transforming how the world produces and consumes energy through bold innovation and commercial excellence.

Masdar is a clean energy investor, developer and operator, advancing renewable energy projects across key markets and technologies, with a global project portfolio capacity to date of over 65 gigawatts (GW).

Jointly owned by TAQA, ADNOC and Mubadala, Masdar is driving the scale-up of renewables worldwide, targeting a portfolio capacity of 100GW by 2030.

Job Description

To lead and manage civil and structural related scope in all Masdar’s renewable energy power projects with main focus on solar PV, wind and storage technologies throughout all project’s lifecycle with less complex nature in terms of partnership structure, project structure, geographical location, technology wise, risk exposure etc. This includes conducting feasibility studies of civil and structural aspects covering the design technical specifications, technical & commercial design optimization and review of proposal packages from external stakeholders.

Key Accountabilities : 

  • Assist in screening methodology for early stage projects, which are in the DD phase and perform detailed project screening.
  • Use all kinds of structural and civil design softwares like (STAAD.PRO, AutoCAD, Solidworks, Etabs, SAFE etc.) to complete project and assigned work.
  • Prepare project’s civil and structural designs, risk reviews, mitigation plans, engineering validations, bill of quantity (BOQ) framing, including review and finalization of drawings and design calculation.
  • Ensure design work is carried out to the agreed standards and codes of practice as per the project requirements and international standards.
  • Prepare and finalize technical specifications & BOQ’s for site investigation works.
  • Select technology and perform cost optimization of civil & structural components for power plant.
  • Design and engineer for the main power plant area which includes drainage, roads, grading & levelling, foundations for invertor station (in case of PV plant), IDT, ET, O&M building & MCR. Specifically for PV plant, design Concrete/Rammed/Predrilled Pile for Tracker/Fixed module mounting structure etc.
